step.cmd: Determine if an acceptable medical certificate is on file:

ul.li: If yes, fact-find with the client or the employer. fact-find
If no, fact-find with the client to request the additional details and the medical certificate. fact-find

step.cmd: Determine if the client or employer was contacted during fact-finding:

ul.li: If the client or employer was contacted, go to step 8.
If the client or employer was not contacted or did not reply to the N-10-00-00 or Z-00-00-00 letter, go to Reassigning the issue to Level 2 . Reassigning the issue to Level 2

step.cmd: In NWS, add details to the draft SROC created during fact-finding or create a new SROC as follows:

ul.li: Main Issue: Select Reason for separation .

Comments: Type one of the following:
If an acceptable medical certificate is on file: “Voluntary leaving — [employer’s name] — [last day worked] — [client or employer].”
If an acceptable medical certificate is not on file: “Conversation with the client — medical proof needed.”
Details: Document the fact-finding details according to the Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy . Fact-Finding and Documentation Policy
